# Current design and product integration

<!-- Generated by tools/sync_current_design.py from design/current_product.json. -->

A common native product candidate, finite OLED/FPC motion studies and bench-coupon artwork are implemented. The current internal FPC candidate is rejected; donor fit, physical assembly and powered-phone operation remain unverified.

## Product and platform

Equal finished A/B envelopes; one approximately 7-inch flexible main OLED; flat storage in B; B moves upward 79.75 mm and seats normally by 8.20 mm; A has larger-cell priority. The 4700 mAh target uses cell-label sum at a common reference voltage; it is not verified terminal Ah for an unknown pack topology and is not a selected cell pair.

The implementation baseline is `a1b3cc1e0773446f2e36d0a607edf61211dd9919`. The donor reuse design decision and unknown physical identities are in [product interfaces](design/product_interfaces.json); project geometry and reservation assumptions are in [product geometry](design/product_geometry.json).

## Validation and research boundaries

Configured unit manifest: **1240 tests / 32 suites**. Run `uv run --locked python -B tools/verify.py`. Run `python3 tools/sync_current_design.py --check` to check these entry points.

- Accepted main baseline: **1187 tests / 31 suites**, functional commit `2303ac50f7f881ca243cc7315718aba99354fd6a`, scope `all_current_unit_suites_via_disjoint_canonical_selections`; [report](engineering/installation-control-20261018/local-unit1187.json.gz).
- Separate PR35 draft: **1216 tests / 31 suites**, functional commit `79b73bb3720bcc5b4e9d86ea6d6c8864988cbd1d`, scope `all_current_unit_suites_via_disjoint_canonical_selections`; [report](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/RAZR-SLIDE/blob/176df31ceb35bb3737d68030e60ba377665de210/engineering/bearing-followup-20261018/full-unit1216.json.gz).

Accepted PR34 evidence closes the retained normalized installation and fixed-adjustment service model. It does not determine real preload, torque, material strength or phone capacity. The original eight cases and later L1/L2 cases remain versioned results, not fresh reruns. The product candidate cuts A_FRAME, A_BACK_PANEL and B_SHELL and adds supports; the original FE closure does not structurally qualify those new solids.

### Open research

- [PR #35](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/RAZR-SLIDE/pull/35) at `176df31ceb35bb3737d68030e60ba377665de210`: P2 edge ordering repaired; finite-point QP passes but 75 body and 1112 bearing regions fail the unchanged global gap target. Next: Real retained-witness coverage has been diagnosed. A 3292-file, 3.24-second read-only cache preflight found no identified bearing response restart; stop before any new FE solve until exact response/points/trace state can be restored.
- [PR #25](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/RAZR-SLIDE/pull/25) at `44a5830f49af73605d5161efff80e6744b0fb468`: Old slack-spring API differs from main; all eight historical global cases remain rejected. Next: The separately named slack_spring_contact adapter now reuses the main solver; tests and a retained legacy comparison are implemented. Reconcile the old draft after publishing the validated replacement change, without merging its old full-body driver.

## Actual build and measurements

Read-only ADB collection was actually executed on the available main host; no authorized donor device was connected. No physical prototype fabrication, cycles, display/touch operation or powered USB continuity is claimed. Native study parts, unpowered bench coupon artwork and a measurement/assembly package are available.

Study CAD can be generated and unpowered research coupons can be prepared while physical inputs remain incomplete. A study export does not assert whole-phone fit, electrical operation or a completed physical test.

Full implementation commands, generated outputs and measured/rejected results are in [the integration delivery](engineering/product-integration-20261018/README.md). Historical entry points remain available at the recorded baseline commit and in the original experiments.
